Green soul-flame pours from the lord's upraised hands, spiralling outward in ghostly tongues that light the whole crypt in a sickly glow.
Skeletal hands claw up out of the cracked earth across the field, the dead dragging themselves into the air at the necromancer's command.
A column of cold necrotic light lances down onto a corpse, jerking it upright as spectral threads bind its limbs into obedience.
Swirling spectral wraiths stream from the tip of a blackened staff, their hollow mouths shrieking as they spiral outward in pale green arcs.
Dark runes burn across the ground in crawling violet fire, each symbol flaring bright as the earth beneath them splits and heaves upward.
Ghostly souls are dragged screaming into a cracked obsidian vessel, their pale forms compressed and swallowed by the pulsing black seal on its surface.
A wave of black death-energy rolls outward from the necromancer's chest, withering grass and cracking stone as it spreads in a foul tide.
Scattered bones skitter and snap together across the floor, reassembling into a full skeleton that rises jerkily, joints clicking with sickly green light.
A glowing sigil-circle of interlocked bones burns in pale yellow-white on the flagstones, its geometry rotating slowly as power builds at the center.
Spirits are torn loose from freshly slain bodies, trailing luminous silver threads that snap taut as the necromancer binds them into shrieking servitude.
A pulse of withering decay radiates outward in muddy brown-green rings, flesh rotting on contact and wood crumbling to black dust where it passes.
Pale ectoplasmic chains erupt from the earth, coiling around a risen corpse and dragging it upright with a sound like snapping frozen rope.
A skull held aloft erupts with violet flame pouring from its eye sockets, the fire spiralling upward in a twisting column twenty feet tall.
Translucent shadow-hounds pour from a tear in the air, trailing black smoke and glowing with faint corpse-light as they race across the battlefield.
The necromancer exhales a long breath of glowing green miasma that rolls low across the ground, reanimating every corpse it washes over in sequence.
Spectral armor coalesces around risen undead warriors, cold blue-white plates of ghostly plate mail snapping into place with sharp cracks of death-energy.
A vortex of churning grave-soil and ash spins above the battlefield, pulling loose bones upward into its funnel and spitting out assembled skeletons below.
Black necrotic tendrils snake outward from a carved wand, piercing the chests of the fallen and pumping sickly luminescence back into their still hearts.
A rift tears open in pale sickly yellow, and a procession of hollow-eyed spirits floods through in a torrent, moaning as they take shape.
Death-light bleeds upward from every crack in the crypt floor simultaneously, each fissure glowing a deep cold green as the mass resurrection begins.
A spectral giant hand descends from the smoke-black ceiling, fingers spreading wide as it presses a soul forcibly back into a shattered broken body.
Bones erupt from the walls like spears, flying across the room and fusing together midair into a lurching skeleton trailing threads of pale grave-fire.
A necromantic sigil blazes on the dragon's chest in searing white-green, pulsing with each heartbeat as it locks the beast's death-magic into the lord's will.
The air crystallizes into a lattice of cold pale-purple necrotic ice, and the dead encased within it twitch, preserved and awaiting the command to shatter free.
Shadow pours from the necromancer's open mouth in a torrent, solidifying into writhing dark figures that fling themselves onto the living with shrieking hollow fury.
